take: Detroit announced it has placed defenseman Albert Johansson on injured reserve. He has played 11 games this season with one assist, and Detroit controls 57% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) at five-on-five when he is on the ice, a share 4 points better than the team manages without him. In the 5 games since he went out, Andreas Englund has moved in beside Johansson's old spot and is up to 14:41 a night from 12:26, while William Wallinder is up to 17:42 from 14:07.
